card.name: Lead-in to antioxidant nutrient lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas and the word mineral inside lists of vitamins, selenium, lycopene or carotene, just before the text says antioxidant. It appears in web passages about free radicals and skin or eye protection.

modes.label: Inside vitamin lists
modes.description: Commas, 'the' or 'mineral' within a run of vitamins A, C, E and selenium.
modes.example: Our bodies naturally suppress free radicals with Vitamins A, C, E and the<< mineral>> Selenium.

modes.label: Linking word before a nutrient
modes.description: 'with' or 'of' leading into lycopene, selenium or glutathione in antioxidant discussion.
modes.example: A good way to do that, it seems, is<< with>> lycopene.

modes.label: Lists of radical scavengers
modes.description: A comma after a named scavenger such as vitamin C or beta-carotene.
